hints.environment: Sandbox takes test payments from sandbox accounts, Live takes real ones. Each environment has its own keys and webhooks.
hints.clientId: From the app under Apps & Credentials in the PayPal Developer Dashboard, for the selected environment.
hints.clientSecret: Shown next to the client ID in the same app.
hints.webhookId: ID of the webhook in the same app. Point the webhook at https://<your backend>/hooks/payment/paypal_<provider id> and subscribe it to PAYMENT.AUTHORIZATION.CREATED and PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED. Without it, the plugin cannot verify PayPal's webhooks and ignores them.
hints.intent: Capture right away takes the money when the customer pays. Authorize only holds the amount, and you capture it from the order in Admin. PayPal guarantees the funds for 3 days and lets you capture within 29 days.
hints.brandName: Shown on PayPal pages instead of the business name of your PayPal account. Up to 127 characters.
hints.landingPage: The page the customer sees first after leaving for PayPal.
hints.softDescriptor: Added after your business name on the customer's card statement. The statement shows 22 characters, PAYPAL * prefix included, so keep it short.
